text:
Date: Announced on 14 March 2025, with Reyes taking the podium at the start of the 2025-26 season.

Named person with a role: Marguerite Oyelaran, chair of the Halewyn Philharmonic board, led the selection committee and made the announcement.

Figure: Reyes signed a five-year contract, chosen from a shortlist of 31 candidates.

Source document or event: The board's official press release, issued after its closed-session vote and read aloud at a press conference at Calder Hall.
